text: Ɓee fodaaɓe ballal ngal ko ɓen woni ɓen tawɓe si Men newiniranii ɓe ka leydi ballal e hoore ayɓe maɓɓe ɓen ɓe tottay Julde nden e noone ɓurɗo timmude, ɓe jonna Jakka jawli maɓɓe ɗen, ɓe yamira ko Sar'ia on yamiri kon, ɓe haɗa ko o haɗi kon. Ko Alla tun heeranii ruttorde fiyakuuji ɗin ka warjagol e ɗum e Leptugol.
